recognize_zh: 抹片中為小至中型、核有切跡或凹陷（cleaved/notched）的淋巴細胞；流式第一次以 CD45 亮陽性設門時 B 細胞為多株（kappa 與 lambda 皆有），第二次在 CD45 陰性區設門才找到 kappa 限制型的 B 細胞群，說明這例濾泡性淋巴瘤細胞不表現 CD45，若只圈 CD45+ 會漏診。
features: Small to medium lymphoid cells with clumped chromatin and notched or cleaved nuclear contours (A-D)
Scant pale cytoplasm; no granules; occasional neutrophils for size comparison (B, C)
Flow E-F: conventional CD45-bright lymphocyte gate shows polytypic CD19+ B cells (kappa and lambda both present)
Flow G-H: lymphocyte gate placed on the CD45-negative/dim low-SSC region reveals a kappa-restricted CD19+ B-cell population
Teaching point: neoplastic cells lie outside the usual CD45-positive lymphocyte gate
describe_en: Composite figure. Smears show small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin, scant cytoplasm and notched to cleaved nuclei (A-D). Flow cytometry with a standard CD45-bright/low side scatter lymphocyte gate identifies polytypic CD19-positive B cells expressing both kappa and lambda (E, F). When the gate is redrawn to include CD45-negative events with low side scatter, a distinct kappa light chain-restricted CD19-positive B-cell population is revealed (G, H). Findings are consistent with involvement by a CD45-negative follicular lymphoma and illustrate that CD45-based gating can miss a clonal B-cell population.

ddx.vs: B-lymphoblasts are often CD45-dim/negative but are surface immunoglobulin-negative with CD34/TdT expression and fine blastic chromatin, whereas these cells carry kappa-restricted sIg.
Plasma cells are commonly CD45-negative but lack CD19 and surface light chains, expressing cytoplasmic light chains with CD38/CD138 bright.
MCL cells have irregular nuclei too but are CD5+ CD10-, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, whereas follicular lymphoma is CD10+ BCL6+ CD5- with t(14;18).
CD45-negative carcinoma cells lack CD19 and surface immunoglobulin and form cohesive clusters on smears.
